notes.title: We've Been Nominated!
notes.content:
[h2][b]CROWDED. FOLLOWED. has been nominated for the Technical Achievement Award as part of The Horror Game Awards! [/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053896/5647895e5e216c827ae9754f0e0563a8e6d8d204.jpg[/img]
[h3] We are so chuffed to have been nominated!
[b]There are 3 days left, so please consider giving us your vote at: thehorrorgameawards.com/vote/[/b]


Thank you!! [/h3]

notes.title: Thank you for 100 reviews!
notes.content:
It’s been four weeks since CROWDED. FOLLOWED. was released, and it's just passed 100 reviews! A huge shoutout to everyone who has played, left a review, recommended it to friends, or supported us in any other way! We’re also incredibly grateful to the streamers and press who’ve featured it—your coverage means the world to us.

We’re over the moon with the response and can’t wait to see what the future holds.

Thank you all!

-NIGHT DIAL & Banshee Games
